scenes.name: THE SELECTION
scenes.desc: Selection Day in a near-future city. A close-up of a young adult in a packed public square, face lit blue by a giant screen; the countdown on it stops. The camera pulls back and up over thousands of people to reveal the screen: one name - theirs. On the stage below the screen a government presenter announces it; broadcast camera cranes swing round. The crowd turns, row after row, to look at them as a camera drone drops toward them.
scenes.actions: The main character (one consistent model in every shot): young adult, short brown hair, rust-red jacket over a grey hoodie, dark trousers, white trainers. Disbelief, then fear. The presenter gestures to the screen; heads turn.
scenes.lighting: Cold blue-grey dusk; the giant screen is the key light on thousands of faces; haze over the square.
scenes.sfx: Huge crowd murmur, digital countdown beeps that stop dead, a sub-bass impact on the name, the presenter's PA reverb (no words), music shifts to a low pulse; the murmur dies as the crowd turns.
scenes.edit: Opens mid-moment (no intro). One continuous pull-back, then two quick cuts. Key caption: YOUR NAME WAS SELECTED.

scenes.name: THE WORLD WATCHES
scenes.desc: Within the hour: two guards walk the character down a long, dark Ministry corridor while ceiling cameras turn to follow them. A news studio: the presenter at the desk, the character's face on the wall behind. A whole apartment block at night, every window lit by the same broadcast. Then a cathedral-sized hall: the character, tiny, under a giant screen with the competition's logo - VANTAGE.
scenes.actions: Walking between the guards, glancing up at the cameras; standing still under the logo, arms by their sides.
scenes.lighting: Dark metallic corridor with cold strip lights; bright studio; blue TV glow in every window; the logo screen as a huge back-light.
scenes.sfx: Footsteps on metal, a security door hiss, camera servos whirring, radio chatter (unintelligible); a TV news sting; a crowd roar from a stadium broadcast; a deep logo hit.
scenes.edit: Quick, broadcast-style cuts. Key caption: MILLIONS ARE WATCHING.

scenes.name: ENTERING THE ARENA
scenes.desc: A tunnel. Giant doors split open and daylight floods in. The reveal: a whole landscape under a vast geodesic dome - dense forest, a river, open meadows, mountains in the haze, slender observation towers with camera pods. A huge countdown display on a gantry runs down to zero. An aerial sweep over the forest and river past the towers, other gates opening along the wall.
scenes.actions: Stands at the threshold, shielding their eyes; steps out onto the grass.
scenes.lighting: Rich, warm sunlight through the dome, haze and light shafts; deep green forest.
scenes.sfx: A massive mechanical unlock and the door rumble, wind rushing in, birds, a river, distant mechanical hums from the towers; the music opens up into a wide, heroic swell.
scenes.edit: The biggest visual moment: one long crane reveal. Key caption: WELCOME TO THE ARENA.

scenes.name: THE REALISATION
scenes.desc: The competition begins. A camera hidden in a tree trunk turns to follow the character. A screen on a tower shows a live map with twelve dots - one of them is them. The sky dims on cue and fog rolls in. Across the river, two other competitors on a ridge. Then the "sky" glitches: for a second the dome's panels show through.
scenes.actions: Moving carefully through the trees; crouching behind rocks; looking up at the dome.
scenes.lighting: Green forest light and shafts of sun, then a sudden cool dimming as the "weather" changes.
scenes.sfx: Forest ambience, a camera servo click, the map's ping, wind rising on cue, a distant rumble that sounds wrong, an electrical crackle as the sky glitches; suspense strings.
scenes.edit: Slower, watchful cuts from hidden-camera angles. Key caption: YOU ARE BEING WATCHED.

scenes.name: THE TWIST
scenes.desc: In a rock face, a seam of light: a concealed door. Inside, a hidden monitoring room - a curved wall of screens with live feeds of the arena, a digital map, and on the back wall a government crest above the competition logo. One screen holds a confidential list of "pre-approved" names - theirs among them, dated weeks before Selection Day.
scenes.actions: Pulls the door open; walks slowly along the screens; reads the list; disbelief turning to anger.
scenes.lighting: Dark room lit only by the screens: cold blue-white faces, red status lights.
scenes.sfx: A heavy door seal, electrical hum, computer chatter, data clicks, digital glitches; rising suspense music.
scenes.edit: Slow push-ins; one rack focus to the list. Key captions: YOU WERE NEVER SUPPOSED TO FIND THIS. / THE COMPETITION WAS RIGGED.

scenes.name: THE FINAL PAYOFF
scenes.desc: The character pushes a master fader on the console marked ALL CHANNELS. The feeds go out: in the city square at night the giant screen glitches and shows the hidden list to the crowd. Back in the room a surveillance camera swings round toward them. They turn and look straight into it. The broadcast breaks up and cuts out.
scenes.actions: Hand on the fader; turns to the camera; holds its gaze, determined.
scenes.lighting: Bright digital screens and hard contrast: the square bathed in white-blue screen light; the final close-up half in monitor light, half in red.
scenes.sfx: A fader thunk, broadcast interference, the crowd's murmur rising in the square, a camera servo, a final huge impact - then the music cuts out completely, leaving a dead signal tone.
scenes.edit: Glitch transitions; the final close-up breaks up and cuts to black (the first shot is the same face, so the Short loops).
